request.prompt:
Extract group trip planning constraints from natural-language preference notes.
Return ONLY raw JSON, no markdown, no backticks. Use this exact top-level shape:
{raw_member_notes: list, raw_group_notes: string, hard_constraints: list, soft_preferences: list, schedule: object, activity_filters: object, meal_requirements: object, destination_intent: object}.
Classify explicit must/avoid/timing requirements as hard_constraints. Classify general likes, vibes, and pacing as soft_preferences unless they are phrased as must/avoid.
Use schedule.earliest_start_time as HH:MM when users avoid early mornings. Use activity_filters.avoid_tags for avoided activity categories. Use meal_requirements.must_include for cuisine or meal requirements. Use destination_intent.styles for destination-level intent like big_city, skyscrapers, skyline, architecture, museums, food_city, nightlife_city, beach, national_park, theme_parks, mountains, small_town, scenic_drives, shopping, quiet_escape. Use destination_intent.preferred_types for preferred destination types, and set destination_intent.iconic_preference true when users ask for iconic, famous, big-city, skyline, national-park, beach, or theme-park destinations.

Preference notes JSON:
{"raw_member_notes": [{"member_id": "alex", "name": "Alex", "notes": "I want hiking, viewpoints, and nature. I am vegan. I hate clubs and do not want alcohol-centered venues."}, {"member_id": "brooke", "name": "Brooke", "notes": "I want museums, architecture, cafes, and iconic city neighborhoods. I do not care about hiking."}, {"member_id": "cam", "name": "Cam", "notes": "I am budget sensitive and gluten-free. No packed schedule. I need downtime every day."}, {"member_id": "dev", "name": "Dev", "notes": "No pork or bacon. I like late dinners, markets, and food halls, but not clubs."}, {"member_id": "ella", "name": "Ella", "notes": "I want boutiques, local markets, photogenic streets, and at least one nicer dinner."}, {"member_id": "finn", "name": "Finn", "notes": "I want beaches or water if possible, but I cannot handle early mornings. Keep travel between stops low."}], "raw_group_notes": "This is a reunion trip with conflicting styles. Hard constraints: no clubs, no alcohol-focused venues, no pork, respect vegan and gluten-free meals, no activity before 10:00 unless it is breakfast. Soft goals: one scenic outdoor day, one museum/culture day, one food-focused day, one shopping or market stop, and enough downtime that the trip does not feel rushed.", "hard_constraints": [], "soft_preferences": [], "schedule": {"avoid_early_mornings": false, "earliest_start_time": null, "pace": "balanced"}, "activity_filters": {"avoid_tags": [], "prefer_tags": [], "required_tags": []}, "meal_requirements": {"must_include": [], "avoid_terms": []}, "destination_intent": {"styles": [], "landmarks": [], "preferred_types": [], "iconic_preference": false}}
